configuration.title: SCMCU
configuration.compilerPath.description: Path to the SCMCU_IDE data\bin directory (containing picc.exe). Automatically detected when empty.
configuration.idePath.description: SCMCU_IDE installation root directory (containing the mcu\config directory). Automatically detected when empty.
configuration.buildDir.description: Build output directory (relative to the project root).
configuration.outputName.description: Output file name without extension. Generates <name>.hex and <name>.scx.
configuration.sourceDirs.description: C source file directories (relative to the project root; empty string = project root). Bare SourceFile names in .scw are searched in this order, then in the project root and common directories (src/source).
configuration.includeDirs.description: Header file include directories (relative to the project root; empty string = project root). These directories are added to -I during compilation.
configuration.device.description: Chip model used when compiling without a .scw project file (e.g. SC8F052A04). When empty, compiling without .scw will report a configuration error.
configuration.configWords.description: The four configuration words used when compiling without .scw (hexadecimal strings, e.g. ["0x1FFF","0x3FFF","0x3FFF","0x3FFF"]). When empty, the chip's default unprogrammed configuration words are used. A warning is shown during compilation; verify hardware options before flashing.
configuration.sourceFiles.description: Source file list used when compiling without .scw (relative to the project root; order matters because it determines compilation order). An empty array automatically scans all .c/.asm/.s files in the project. A non-empty array compiles only the listed files in order. Manage this list using the Source File Manager panel. Takes precedence over automatic scanning.
configuration.noScwBehavior.description: Behavior when no .scw file is found. prompt = ask; load = load directly; skip = do not load. The dialog options Remember and Load / Remember and Don't Load are saved to this setting.
configuration.noScwBehavior.prompt: When opening a workspace with no .scw file, ask whether to load the extension each time.
configuration.noScwBehavior.load: Do not ask again. Load the extension directly (without .scw mode).
configuration.noScwBehavior.skip: Do not ask again and do not load the extension (treat as a non-SCMCU project).
configuration.writerPath.description: SCMCU Writer (programmer host software) installation directory, e.g. F:/Work/SCMCU_Writer_V9.01.16. When empty, automatically scan drive root directories for SCMCU_Writer* folders.
configuration.flashCount.description: Maximum offline programming count (WriterCount; 0 = unlimited, default 0). A value of 0 allows unlimited programming. A positive integer limits how many times the programmer can flash this firmware (for production over-programming prevention). Note: this is not the number of chips to program; it is the maximum number of programming operations allowed for this firmware.
